en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a grand neoclassical building with a columned portico, framed by manicured hedges and trees in the foreground. The bottom left of the image bears the text 'Botaniska Trädgården.' and 'Upsala' in red print. There is handwritten text in Swedish at the bottom and around the border of the image. The reverse of the postcard has ornate green borders, a green 5 öre Swedish stamp, the heading 'BREFKORT.', and is addressed in Swedish to a recipient in Vänersborg. The sender's message area is on the photograph side, as per early postcard formats.
